name: HelpDesk AI (LLM support chatbot)
description: Customer-support chatbot for a B2B SaaS product. Answers tickets in web chat and email using RAG over ~20k help-center articles, escalates to humans, and drafts replies for agents. ~150k conversations/month, English plus Spanish and German.

context.llm: OpenAI GPT models via API for answers; small model for intent routing
context.retrieval: OpenAI embeddings + pgvector; hybrid BM25 rerank
context.stack: Python FastAPI backend, LangChain, Postgres, Redis, React widget
constraints: GDPR: EU customer data must stay in EU
SOC 2; no training on customer data
Hallucinated policy answers are a top escalation cause
